pages.title: Juniper Bakery
pages.h1: Bread out of the oven at 7. Cakes by order.

findings.title: robots.txt blocks the whole site
findings.detail: `Disallow: /` for every crawler, usually left over from staging. Nothing will be indexed.

findings.title: robots.txt has no Sitemap line
findings.detail: Add `Sitemap: https://…/sitemap.xml`.

findings.title: sitemap.xml missing
findings.detail: Without it, search engines find pages only through links.

findings.title: 404 page
findings.detail: returns 404, but with the server's bare error page. Add a page with a way back.

findings.title: HTTPS, redirects and headers
findings.detail: Checked on the live domain only. Run again after deploy.

findings.title: No canonical
findings.detail: Copies of the page with query strings compete with it.

findings.title: No share image
findings.detail: Links to this page share without a picture. /coleoni-og makes one from the page.

findings.title: 1 console error
findings.detail: initMap is not defined

findings.title: Old copyright year
findings.detail: Footer says 2024.

findings.title: 1 link to nowhere
findings.detail: “Instagram” points to #.

findings.title: 1 image without alt
findings.detail: Screen readers read the file name. Describe it, or `alt=""` if it is decoration. /coleoni-a11y checks the rest.

findings.title: noindex is on
findings.detail: `noindex, nofollow`. Usually left over from staging; the page will not appear in search.

findings.title: No meta description
findings.detail: Search results and previews make one up from random text.

findings.title: No canonical
findings.detail: Copies of the page with query strings compete with it.

findings.title: No share image
findings.detail: Links to this page share without a picture. /coleoni-og makes one from the page.

findings.title: Page scrolls sideways on the phone
findings.detail: 350px wider than the screen, starting at `table`.

findings.title: Placeholder: Lorem ipsum
findings.detail: “…kes by order, 48 hours ahead. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur a…”

findings.title: Page answers 404
findings.detail: “Visit” on / leads here.

findings.title: Same title on several pages
findings.detail: “Juniper Bakery” on 2 pages; search results look identical.

findings.title: No analytics found
findings.detail: Fine if on purpose. Without it, there is no way to know if the launch worked.
